handlingTags.description: Non-empty, duplicate-free set of handling tags from the closed enum. Order is not significant.

temperatureClass.description: Required if and only if handlingTags includes TemperatureSensitive; omit/empty otherwise.

dotHazardClass.description: Optional top-level US DOT hazard class (1-9; explosives sub-divisions/compatibility-groups A-L/S are out of scope — see ADR 0010). Meaningful, and settable, only when handlingTags includes Hazmat — but unlike temperatureClass, never REQUIRED by Hazmat: omit/null for a Hazmat classification with no DOT class on file (e.g. one classified before this field existed).
